text:
sasha: Quick ping — slotting RFCs for next Wed's review. We have room for 4 short slots (20m) or 2 long (40m). Proposing a compact agenda so folks in EMEA can join for the first half. TL;DR: need authors to post 1-paragraph pre-read + what to focus on by Tue 11:59 PT.

peter: 20m x4 sounds good to me. I can take notes if someone else volunteers to timebox.

juhi: I can reviewer-coverage two short slots (morning PT). Which RFCs are we aiming for?

sasha: Current queue: 1) storage-indexing-proposal (Carlos) 2) request-routing-fallback (Juhi) 3) runtime-kv-cache (Peter) 4) json-schema-output (Tess). If you prefer long slots, we can collapse 1+2 into a 40m deep-dive.

carlos: I'll post the storage-indexing-proposal pre-read now. Will include a 3-point checklist: assumptions, perf tradeoffs, rollout plan. Short TL;DR at top.

tess: Quick ask — can we do the JSON schema output slot earlier? I have a customer sync at 11:30 PT. If we go 20m slots, earlier is better.

sasha: Noted. Tentative order then: 1) json-schema-output (Tess) 2) runtime-kv-cache (Peter) 3) storage-indexing (Carlos) 4) request-routing (Juhi). If someone needs swap, shout now.

juhi: I need two reviewers on request-routing because of the fallback matrix. Can Pete + Sasha be reviewers? @peter @sasha

peter: I can do reviewer for routing but would prefer to pair with juhi for the later follow-up.

sasha: I can review but might be 10 min late — travel. If I'm late, deploy-bot, please bump the next slot by 5m. :grimacing:

calendar-bot: Event created — "RFC Review: compact slots" Wed 17 March 2026 09:00 PT. Invite includes agenda and pre-read links.

carlos: PSA: I'm attaching a tiny diff gist and the perf run command in the pre-read. Please run locally if you want to sanity-check numbers:
```bash
git fetch origin && git checkout c-index-rfc
make perf-run TARGET=local ITER=10
```

tess: Done — pre-read posted and TL;DR pinned. Asking reviewers to look at the sample output at the bottom. :eyes:

juhi: If anyone can do a quick sanity check on fallback matrices before Tue 5pm PT that would be huge — I'll update based on feedback.

peter: I'll glance tonight, won't do full run. If something looks off I'll flag in-thread.

sasha: Two operational asks: 1) authors add one-line deploy-risk (low/med/high) and rollback step in pre-read; 2) label any sections that require architecture signoff. Makes the meeting faster.

tess: Added deploy-risk and signoff tags. Also volunteered to be timekeeper for first two slots.

carlos: happy to swap slots with tess if that helps timing. I prefer later but can move.

sasha: OK doing a quick poll — reply with "take earlier" if you want to move earlier, otherwise we'll keep current order. Also, if anyone can volunteer to be alternate note-taker (incase Peter gets pulled), ping here.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: Pre-read deadline Tue 23:59 PT. Automated check will verify each RFC has a TL;DR and deploy-risk tag. Missing fields will be listed in the morning digest.

peter: I can be backup note-taker. Also can we timebox Q&A to 5m per short slot? Keeps us on schedule.

sasha: Yup — 5m Q&A, +5m buffer per pair of slots for overruns. If a slot needs deeper discussion we mark it for follow-up breakout.

juhi: Sounds good. I'll add a one-slide summary for the fallback matrix to the pre-read.

carlos: swap with tess confirmed — I'm later. Thanks.

sasha: Great — final checklist: authors post TL;DR + deploy-risk + one-line rollback by Tue 11:59 PT; reviewers confirm coverage by Tue EOD; timekeeper + notes confirmed. We'll run 20m slots with 5m Q&A. See you Wed. :thumbsup:
